source.description:
PROBLEM:
The seconder specialist (config/specialists/seconder.specialist.json) is configured READ_ONLY with worktree:none. When dispatched via sp run seconder --job <exec-job>, the runtime injects NO shell/read_file/bash tools (verified across 2 dispatches: jobs eff40d + 13e21b both completed 0 tool calls in 2 turns). Its only window into the writer's diff is the injected writer_diff payload component, which truncates for diffs ~600 lines (observed 2026-06-16 on unitAI-oeysi feature/unitAI-oeysi-executor with 6 files / +622 lines).

Result: seconder cannot return PASS/FAIL on diffs above some size threshold — verdict is always UNCLEAR with 'truncation' as the cited cause. The mandatory seconder gate becomes structurally unreachable.

SUCCESS:
Seconder verdicts on representative production-size diffs (500-1500 lines) successfully — either by raising prompt_limit_bytes for the writer_diff component, or by giving seconder a minimal read_file/bash tool when running under READ_ONLY + reused worktree.

SCRUTINY: medium

SCOPE:
- config/specialists/seconder.specialist.json (prompt_limit_bytes is currently 80000)
- src/specialist/runner.ts or wherever writer_diff payload is composed (search for 'writer_diff')
- Whatever permission gate filters tools for READ_ONLY worktree:none specialists

NON_GOALS:
- no full re-architecture of payload composition
- no change to other READ_ONLY specialists unless they share the same path

CONSTRAINTS:
- READ_ONLY behavior preserved (no write/edit)
- Per-spec opt-in if a runtime change to tool injection is needed

VALIDATION:
- Reproduce the failure: dispatch seconder against any diff > 500 lines, verdict comes back UNCLEAR/PARTIAL with no tool calls
- After fix: same diff verdicts with PASS/FAIL and concrete file:line findings

OUTPUT: bug fix + memory update on seconder runtime semantics.

DISCOVERED-FROM: orchestration of unitAI-oeysi 2026-06-16, memory key 'seconder-gate-unreachable-on-net-new-file-diffs-2026-06-16'.
source.title: BUG: seconder gate cannot verdict from disk on net-new-file diffs
